h1: TK Palace Hotel & Convention Chaeng Watthana — 4-Star with Two Pools, MRT Pink Line Just 3 Minutes on Foot, Steps from Bangkok's Government Hub
intro: For anyone heading to the Chaeng Watthana Government Complex, attending a conference, or simply wanting a comfortable base in Bangkok's northern business belt without depending on a taxi every time — TK Palace Hotel & Convention is the 4-star option that locals in the area keep returning to. The hotel sits at 54/7 Chaeng Watthana Road, Soi 15, Lak Si, with the MRT Pink Line (Station Chaeng Watthana 14) just 200 metres from the front door — a 3-minute walk. Two swimming pools (indoor and outdoor), a free fitness centre, sauna, spa, WYNN Café & Bistro restaurant and a full convention centre set it apart from the budget pack at this price point. Real guest score: 8.7 out of 10 from 707 verified reviews. Standard rooms start from approx. ฿1,350–1,750 per night depending on season and availability.

Swimming pool at TK Palace Hotel Bangkok — calm and well-maintained, available to all guests
WYNN Café & Bistro at TK Palace Hotel Chaeng Watthana — relaxed dining with Thai and international options

body.html: TK Palace Hotel & Convention occupies a strategic address on Chaeng Watthana Road, Soi 15 in Lak Si — a district that Bangkok insiders know as the city's northern government and business corridor. The hotel's defining advantage is its distance from the MRT Pink Line: 200 metres to Station Chaeng Watthana 14, or roughly a 3-minute walk. From there, the Pink Line runs the length of Chaeng Watthana Road and connects at Lak Si to the Red Line, putting Don Mueang Airport and Bang Sue Grand Station (northern rail hub) within easy reach. Big C Supercenter is 400 metres in the opposite direction.

Room types run from Standard Rooms at 25 sqm — king or twin bed, 32-inch TV, mini-fridge, coffee and tea maker, hot-cold shower, complimentary water and slippers — up through Superior Rooms (29 sqm), Deluxe Rooms, and Mini Suites. Guest reviews consistently mention room size as a positive surprise: "spacious for the price" and "bed is very comfortable" come up repeatedly across platforms. That said, reviewers also note that some rooms in older wings show their age — requesting a renovated room at the time of booking is the practical workaround.
"Room was clean, large and the bed was comfortable. Staff very friendly and helpful. The walk to the MRT Pink Line takes 3 minutes — perfect for government business trips."

What genuinely separates TK Palace from comparable-priced hotels in the Chaeng Watthana area is the breadth of leisure facilities. Two swimming pools — indoor and outdoor — plus a free gym, sauna and spa mean this is not just a conference-circuit sleep stop. Guests who need to decompress after a long government meeting or a full event day have real options on-site. The WYNN Café & Bistro is praised in reviews for a solid buffet breakfast with local Thai dishes, though a handful of guests note that complimentary water in-room is limited to two bottles per day with top-ups sometimes hard to obtain.

On the convention side, TK Palace has positioned itself firmly in the mid-to-large events market: function rooms accommodate conferences, seminars and wedding receptions. This means that during peak corporate and government event periods the property fills quickly and rates rise noticeably. Booking ahead of 3–4 weeks is advisable whenever a large event is scheduled nearby — whether at the Government Complex or at IMPACT Arena Muang Thong Thani (11 minutes by car).

The neighbourhood context deserves mention: Chaeng Watthana is emphatically not a tourist district. The surrounding area is dominated by government offices, residential blocks and industrial estates. The Royal Government Complex (home to the Department of Consular Affairs, Immigration Bureau, Administrative Court and 57 other agencies) is 2 km away. Central Chaeng Watthana mall is 4 km. For sightseeing within Bangkok, you will need the MRT or a taxi — but for anyone here on business, this is precisely the right location.

Across 707 real guest reviews, scores break down as follows: cleanliness 8.8, service 8.8, location 8.8, amenities 8.4. Minor complaints centre on noisy air conditioning in some rooms, an older feel in parts of the property, and a slightly bureaucratic deposits policy — none of these are deal-breakers, but they are worth noting before you book. Overall, at ฿1,350–1,750 per night for a 4-star hotel with two pools and MRT access, the value proposition is clear in Bangkok's northern corridor.

Bottom line: TK Palace Hotel & Convention is the most complete 4-star choice in the Chaeng Watthana belt when you weigh price against facilities — two pools, spa, free parking, MRT Pink Line 200 m. It is best suited to business travellers, government-office visitors, conference delegates, and anyone flying out of Don Mueang who wants one more comfortable night without overpaying. Ask for a renovated room, use the pool in the morning, and the Pink Line for everything else.

honestSummary: TK Palace Hotel & Convention delivers the most complete 4-star package in the Chaeng Watthana corridor: MRT Pink Line on your doorstep, two pools, spa and free parking at a price that remains sensible. Just be aware that parts of the property are ageing — request a renovated room and the experience steps up considerably.
honestChecks: If you are sensitive to noise or expect uniformly fresh interiors — note that older wing rooms can have loud air conditioning and ageing furnishings. Specify a renovated room clearly at booking, ideally on a higher floor → eliminates most of the complaints you will read in reviews.

If you need to attend a major event at IMPACT Arena or the Government Complex — rates rise sharply and rooms fill fast during peak event weeks. Book 3–4 weeks ahead minimum and lock in free-cancellation rates while you can.

If you plan to sightsee across central Bangkok every day — Chaeng Watthana is 45–60 minutes from most tourist sites; the MRT Pink Line helps but central Bangkok remains a trip. TK Palace is ideal for government/business visits, not a base for Khao San Road or Sukhumvit nightlife.

tips.title: Request a Renovated Room
tips.body: Mention at booking or on check-in that you would prefer a recently refreshed room — avoids the older-wing units with dated furniture and noisy AC that show up in negative reviews.

tips.title: Use the MRT Pink Line Throughout
tips.body: Head left from the hotel exit and the station is 200 m away. Use the Pink Line to reach the Government Complex, Central Chaeng Watthana, and connect via the Red Line to Don Mueang or Bang Sue — saves money and beats Bangkok traffic every time.

tips.title: Swim Early for a Quiet Pool
tips.body: The pools are TK Palace's real selling point over same-priced rivals. Before 9 am they are nearly empty — ideal for a morning swim before a full day of meetings or government appointments.

tips.title: Avoid IMPACT Event Weeks
tips.body: When IMPACT Arena or the Government Complex hosts a large event, room rates jump and availability shrinks across the whole Chaeng Watthana area. Check the IMPACT calendar before booking if budget is a factor.

faqTitle: FAQ — TK Palace Hotel & Convention Chaeng Watthana

faq.q: Where is TK Palace Hotel & Convention located and what is nearby?
faq.a: TK Palace Hotel is at 54/7 Chaeng Watthana Road, Soi 15, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210. The MRT Pink Line (Station Chaeng Watthana 14) is 200 metres away — a 3-minute walk. Big C Supercenter is 400 m. The Royal Government Complex is 2 km, Central Chaeng Watthana mall is 4 km, and Don Mueang Airport is around 20 minutes by car.

faq.q: What are the room types and prices at TK Palace Hotel?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿1,350 per night for a Standard Room (25 sqm, king or twin). Superior Rooms (29 sqm) run from ฿1,600+, Deluxe Rooms from ฿1,900+, and Mini Suites from ฿2,900+. Rates rise during large events at the Government Complex or IMPACT Arena nearby.

faq.q: Does TK Palace Hotel have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes — TK Palace has two swimming pools: one indoor and one outdoor, along with a free fitness centre, sauna and spa. These facilities are included for hotel guests and represent good value at this price tier for Bangkok's northern area.

faq.q: Is TK Palace Hotel good for visiting the Bangkok Government Complex?
faq.a: It is one of the best options for that purpose. The hotel is just 2 km from the Royal Government Complex (home to Consular Affairs, Immigration Bureau, Administrative Court and dozens of other agencies). The MRT Pink Line from the hotel doorstep takes you directly to the Complex area.

faq.q: How do I get from TK Palace Hotel to Don Mueang Airport?
faq.a: The quickest option is taxi or ride-hail, which takes around 20 minutes. Alternatively, walk 200 m to Chaeng Watthana MRT Station 14, ride the Pink Line to Lak Si, transfer to the Red Line and ride to Don Mueang — total roughly 35–45 minutes and considerably cheaper.

faq.q: Is free parking available at TK Palace Hotel?
faq.a: Yes — free parking is available and described by guests as spacious. This is a notable advantage for visitors driving in from suburban areas north of Bangkok who prefer not to pay extra for parking on top of the room rate.
